records.found: On 2026-11-05 a registry-based study of kidney transplant recipients on rapamycin found no survival gain (against, but observational and not a placebo trial). A 90-day pilot combining rapamycin and metformin (NCT07475546) was marked completed on 2026-10-30 with no results. No controlled human lifespan trial reported, and nothing was found on the metformin trial TAME.

findings.what: Geroscience paper, US transplant registry, 4,885 kidney transplant recipients on rapamycin vs 6,589 not: median survival age 64.6 vs 64.3 years, no meaningful survival gain. Observational, in transplant patients, not a controlled trial.
Registry record NCT07475546 (AgelessRx, 26 people, 90 days, randomised pilot of drug combinations including rapamycin and metformin) updated and marked completed; no results posted.
AMICO metformin-in-COPD trial design paper (212 patients, 36 months, lung function endpoint): a design, not a result, and not a lifespan trial.

A 2026-11-07 preprint-server paper on Medicaid coverage withdrawal and GLP-1 dispensing bears on uptake but was seen by title only. No new regulator action found.
